title: Exempt PR #9 squash f2a8453 from the history check
summary: Add the PR #9 squash commit f2a8453380196b95f2e2cc629ffa969af57e6c85 (OP-11) to `[history] exempt` in athena.toml, as was done for ee4b0dd in D67. Add an explanatory comment, a decision entry and a CHANGELOG line. No code changes.

defaults_applied.how: The request is one line. The precedent in athena.toml, D67 and D68 supplies the form: full id, comment, decision entry, changelog.
One config entry plus its record. No code changes.
The comment and decision entry state what PR #9 and OP-11 are and why the commit is excused.
The existing history check and the D60/D61 exempt validation enforce the entry. No new mechanism.
The verifier runs cargo test and the history check.

assumptions: The id f2a8453380196b95f2e2cc629ffa969af57e6c85 is the real full id of the PR #9 squash commit on main. The snapshot lacks git history, so this cannot be checked here.
The exemption is the same kind as D67's: a single `[history] exempt` entry plus a comment. No code, tests or workflows change.
PR #9 failed the history check for the same reason as ee4b0dd, a squash carrying several jobs. D69 may have since added chain-aware landing. The user wants the exemption either way.
The exemption is recorded as the next decision after D69, with a CHANGELOG line, as D67 was.

acceptance_criteria.text: athena.toml `[history] exempt` contains the full 40-character id f2a8453380196b95f2e2cc629ffa969af57e6c85 in addition to the three existing entries, which are unchanged.
The comment above `exempt` in athena.toml says f2a8453 is the squash of PR #9 (OP-11) and gives the reason, in the style of the ee4b0dd comment.

docs/decisions.md gains a new numbered decision after D69 that records the exemption: the decision, the alternatives, the tradeoff, the reversal (delete the entry) and the provenance (user request). It cites D60, D67 and D68.
CHANGELOG.md has an entry saying the history check no longer judges f2a8453.
Run `cargo test`: all tests pass, including any that parse athena.toml and validate the exempt list (full id, already in history).

Run `cargo run -- check` or the repository's history check subcommand if one exists. It reports no violation for f2a8453. Run `git diff` and confirm only athena.toml, docs/decisions.md and CHANGELOG.md changed.

out_of_scope: Changing gate or landing code, tests or workflows.
Rewriting history or changing how PRs are merged.
Re-exempting or removing the existing exempt entries.
departures: Slightly cheaper than the reference because this is a one-line config change with a clear precedent (D67). The risk is the verifier being unable to confirm the commit id without git history.
